proposed_widenings.name: non_reaction_triggered_magic_item_ability
proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines ordinary charge-cast activation with a separate trigger-bound property that fires on a failed save but does not spend a Reaction. Existing magic-item families only cover passive, activation, triggered_reaction, or composites over those shapes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn."

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.save_outcome_against_spell
proposed_widenings.justification: Reflect Enchantment keys off succeeding on a saving throw against a spell with additional filters: school = Enchantment and target scope = only you. Current trigger variants only cover attack hits, named-spell targeting, or generic spellcasting components.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you succeed on a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell."

proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.modify_roll_substitute_or_save_outcome_override
proposed_widenings.justification: Resist Enchantment upgrades a failed saving throw into a successful one. The authored surface has no effect atom or resolution variant for substituting or overriding a save outcome after the roll is known.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one."

notes: The cast-spell property fits the existing charge-pool activation surface, and Reflect Enchantment is close because reflect_triggering_spell already exists. The honest blocker is the item's second property: it is a triggered, non-reaction save-outcome override, which no current magic-item mechanics family can encode.
